note: Every difference between the frozen pre-migration baseline and the candidate prompts, with an explicit classification and justification. The approved_candidate_sha256 binds these categories to the exact complete ordered candidate prompt set, so a broad category cannot approve a later mutation. scripts/prompt_migration_gate.py fails on any unclassified difference or candidate fingerprint mismatch. Patterns use fnmatch globs.
